messages.subject: Multilevel SEM with Moderated Mediation
parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

This seminar offers a comprehensive introduction to advanced statistical modeling techniques for complex data structures. Multilevel SEM with Moderated Mediation in R led by Michael Zyphur (University of Queensland and Instats) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. The seminar introduces multilevel modeling in Lavaan, covering concepts from hierarchical data to advanced applications like multilevel SEM and CFA. Participants will learn to conduct sophisticated analyses, including multilevel mediation, moderation, and moderated mediation, using real-world data in Lavaan. This knowledge will empower researchers to apply advanced latent variable analysis methods to their own multilevel data, enhancing the quality and insights of their research.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
